result_text:
The warehouse stock list no longer shows products with zero quantity. The full test suite passes (`mvn -q -o test`, no failures reported).

**Change:** In `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`, `listStockByWarehouse` now adds `AND s.quantity > 0` to its WHERE clause, matching the other stock overviews. I split the SQL string across two lines to keep the line length reasonable.

`getQuantity` is untouched, so asking for nuts in WH-1 still returns 0. The only callers of the list are `StockService.getWarehouseStock` and a print loop in `DemoScenario`, so nothing else depends on zero rows.

I did not add a test for the zero-quantity case, and nothing is committed.
